details:
Q1. What exact repo area should this issue target?
Choices:
A. One specific workflow, script, or file — name the exact path/file (RECOMMENDED)
B. One specific pipeline phase — name it: clarify, plan, implement, review_autofix, validate, or orchestrate
C. Docs/README only — name the exact file/section
D. Another specific area — describe it precisely
Q2. What concrete improvement do you want in that area?
Choices:
A. Fix a specific bug/regression — include the current behavior, expected behavior, and any failing run/error text (RECOMMENDED)
B. Remove a manual step or improve automation — include the exact manual step or recurring failure
C. Reduce time/cost/noise — include what is too slow/expensive/noisy and where you observed it
D. Improve wording/documentation — include the exact section and the desired change
